XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Central locking malfunction, airbag, power steering and general fault warning lights illuminated.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | BODY | COMPUTER | B1003 | B1053 | C1003 | C1212 | C1215 | U0001 | U0019 | U0426 | U1700 | U1702 | U1706 | U1715 | WORKS | OPERATION | DOORS | OPENS | CLOSES | GENERIC | PANEL | INSTRUMENTS | DISPLAY | SCREEN | AIRBAG | STEERING |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer

  • Fault: Generic fault warning light, airbag and steering fault warning light illuminated. Central locking not functioning

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • B1003 (Remote control receiver module – Receiver, remote control)
    • C1003 (Speed signal – Wiring / control unit)
    • C1212 (Incorrect engine torque signal – Control unit)
    • C1215 (Brake pedal switch – Wiring / switch)
    • U0001 (CAN BUS C)
    • U0019 (CAN BUS B – general electrical fault)
    • U0426 (Electronic key – error)
    • U1700 (CAN data bus – Body computer – Error)
    • U1702 (CAN data bus – Power steering control unit – Error)
    • U1706 (CAN data bus – ABS control unit – error)
    • U1715 (Yaw/lateral acceleration node – error)
  • Cause: Faulty body computer

• Action: Check that the body computer is functioning correctly and assess its condition; replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this particular case, no reprogramming using diagnostic equipment was required following the replacement.
